newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia Olympic village construction cleared.
newsitem.headline: Australia Olympic village construction cleared.

text.p: The state government of New South Wales said on Wednesday it had given planning clearance for the construction of the village for the Sydney 2000 Olympics.
New South Wales Minister for Urban Affairs and Planning, Craig Knowles, said he had approved the development application from the Olympic Co-ordination Authority.
"The Olympic village will be a showpiece of good environmental design with an emphasis on public transport," Knowles said in a statement.
In December last year a consortium led by property developer Mirvac Ltd won the bid to build the A$470 million village, which will accomodate 15,000 athletes during the Games.
After the games the village will become a Sydney suburb with 1,600 dwellings housing an estimated 5,000 people.
